limits_en: Print a behavioral current-source block, auxiliary capacitor and hysteretic logic. Do not relabel the current source as a simulated JFET microscopic device. limits_en: The underlying bench is series R-L-C; numbered functional blocks do not embody its wiring topology. source_limits_en: Linearized series-RLC surrogate about a bus voltage, not a literal shunt RC snubber design. Initial disturbance amplitude is prescribed. No switching-edge excitation, EMI prediction, nonlinear Coss or snubber recurring power estimate. Do not copy its Rcritical into a real shunt snubber. Numerical refinement reduces selected discretization errors, not unknown physical modeling error.
source_limits_zh: 母线附近线性化串联RLC替代模型，不是实际并联RC吸收器设计；初始扰动人为规定。无开关边沿激励、EMI预测、非线性Coss或吸收器周期功率；不得将临界电阻直接用于真实并联吸收器。 数值改进降低指定离散误差，不代表未知物理建模误差降低。
source_model_en: Series RLC free response: C dv/dt=i; L di/dt=-v-Ri. Rcritical=2 sqrt(L/C), not the parallel-RLC critical resistance. E=0.5 Cv^2+0.5 Li^2; dE/dt=-Ri^2.

name_en: DC/DC separated losses and thermal budget

terminals.label: PLOSS
terminals.role_zh: 热模型的损耗功率输入

limits_en: Print electrical-loss categories feeding one effective thermal node. This is a loss ledger, not a literal chip cross-section; THOT is not an individual MOS junction temperature. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. Circuit blocks show functional relationships and are not transistor layouts. The physical equations and numerical results remain unchanged.
limits_zh: 打印电损耗分类流入一个等效热节点。这是损耗预算，非真实芯片截面；THOT不是单个MOS结温。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；电路图块表示功能关系，不是晶体管版图。物理方程和数值结果保持不变。
source_limits_en: A ledger, not one self-consistent switched electrical/thermal simulation. Two matched Coss curves, one hard upper turn-on per cycle, opposite edge ideal energy redistribution; Coss subterm energies are explanatory and only their sum enters the loss ledger. Overlap includes load-channel current only; Qrr is separate, with no reused full Eon. Vin Qrr is conservative full-bus energy, not diode heat. All heat shares one effective node, not a MOS junction; the thermal transient holds converged loss constant. No core/ESR/reliability/layout loss or measured efficiency. Numerical refinement reduces selected discretization errors, not unknown physical modeling error.
source_limits_zh: 此为预算表，非完整自洽开关电热仿真；两管Coss相同，每周期一次高侧硬导通，另一边沿假定理想能量再分配；Coss子项能量用于解释，仅其和计入损耗。交叠仅含负载沟道电流，Qrr单列，不重复使用完整Eon。VinQrr为全母线保守能量，非二极管热；所有热量共用一个等效节点，非MOS结温，热瞬态固定收敛损耗。不含磁芯、ESR、可靠性、版图损耗或实测效率。 数值改进降低指定离散误差，不代表未知物理建模误差降低。
source_model_en: Matched Coss hard-turn-on energy: Eupper+(Vin Qlower-Elower)=Vin Qoss. Ploss=HS/LS conduction+L copper+channel overlap+Vin Qoss fs+Vin Qrr fs+two Qg Vdrive fs+dead-time diode+control. Solve Thot=Tamb+Rtheta Ploss(Thot). Fixed-loss transient: Thot(t)=Tamb+Ploss Rtheta (1-exp(-t/Rtheta Ctheta)).
source_model_zh: 两管相同Coss：高侧放电储能加低侧充电耗散为Eupper+(VinQlower-Elower)=VinQoss；计一次硬导通/周期，另加导通、铜损、沟道交叠、恢复母线估算、两管栅驱、死区和控制损耗；求等效热节点反馈不动点，再计算恒损耗热瞬态。

limits_en: Print a functional average-control path and power stage. Duty and current reference are abstract signals; there are no resolved PWM edges or verified cycle-by-cycle peak protection. Teaching geometry is enlarged and not to scale. Circuit blocks show functional relationships and are not transistor layouts. The physical equations and numerical results remain unchanged.
limits_zh: 打印平均控制路径及功率级功能图。占空比与电流参考为抽象信号；没有解析PWM边沿或验证逐周期峰值保护。教学几何经放大且不按真实比例；电路图块表示功能关系，不是晶体管版图。物理方程和数值结果保持不变。
source_limits_en: Continuous averaged duty, not PWM edges. A current-reference ceiling is not cycle-by-cycle peak protection; high-frequency overshoot, blanking and inductor saturation are absent. P08 switching losses are not inserted into this plant. Saved traces are decimated; energy metrics use every integration step. No sampled-cycle, slope-compensation, subharmonic or hardware-stability prediction. Numerical refinement reduces selected discretization errors, not unknown physical modeling error.
source_limits_zh: 连续平均占空比，非PWM边沿；电流参考上限不是逐周期峰值保护，无高频过冲、消隐与电感饱和。未将P08开关损耗注入功率级；显示曲线抽取，能量指标使用全部积分步。不预测采样周期、斜坡补偿、次谐波或硬件稳定性。 数值改进降低指定离散误差，不代表未知物理建模误差降低。
source_model_en: L di/dt=D Vin-R i-v; C dv/dt=i-v/Rload. PI voltage loop commands a finite-bandwidth current loop. Reference ramps to 12 V in 2 ms; current command clips at 1.6 A with conditional-integration anti-windup.
source_model_zh: 平均功率级由电压PI环和有限带宽电流环控制；2ms参考斜坡、1.6A电流指令上限及条件积分抗饱和。
